name: 3x-ui
description: A web-based Xray panel for managing proxy inbounds, clients, traffic, and subscriptions, backed by its built-in SQLite database.

configFields.label: Initial panel username
configFields.help: Used only to initialize the first 3x-ui login.

configFields.label: Initial panel password
configFields.help: Auto-generated and applied to 3x-ui on its first deployment.

prepare.command:
marker=/etc/x-ui/.openship-credentials-initialized; credentials=/etc/x-ui/.openship-initial-credentials; if [ -f "$marker" ]; then if [ ! -s "$credentials" ] && [ -n "$XUI_INITIAL_USERNAME" ] && [ -n "$XUI_INITIAL_PASSWORD" ]; then umask 077; printf 'XUI_INITIAL_USERNAME=%s
XUI_INITIAL_PASSWORD=%s
' "$XUI_INITIAL_USERNAME" "$XUI_INITIAL_PASSWORD" > "$credentials"; fi; printf 'credentials-ready
'; else username=${XUI_INITIAL_USERNAME:-admin}; password=${XUI_INITIAL_PASSWORD:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}; /app/x-ui setting -username "$username" -password "$password" >/dev/null; umask 077; printf 'XUI_INITIAL_USERNAME=%s
XUI_INITIAL_PASSWORD=%s
' "$username" "$password" > "$credentials"; touch "$marker"; printf 'credentials-ready
'; fi

description.en: Use these initial credentials to sign in. If you later change the username or password inside 3x-ui, this card keeps showing the original values and will not reset your new credentials on redeploy.
description.zh: 使用以下初始凭据登录。如果之后在 3x-ui 内修改用户名或密码，此卡片仍会显示最初的值；重新部署也不会把新凭据重置回初始值。

help.en: This does not update after you change the username in 3x-ui.
help.zh: 在 3x-ui 内修改用户名后，此处不会同步更新。

help.en: This is the original generated password. It cannot reflect a password changed inside 3x-ui.
help.zh: 这是最初生成的密码，无法反映之后在 3x-ui 内修改的新密码。
